warmupText: Hello, this is a short voice test.

paragraphs.title: Catching up
paragraphs.text: Hey, it's been a while! I was just grabbing a coffee nearby, and I wondered if you had a few minutes to sit down and catch up.

paragraphs.title: Breakfast to go
paragraphs.text: Could I get two egg sandwiches to go, please? No cheese on the first one, and a little extra pepper on the second. I'll take a small iced coffee as well.

paragraphs.title: Before you head out
paragraphs.text: It looks like the rain might start any minute, so remember to take an umbrella. Send me a quick message when you get home, just so I know you made it back safely.

paragraphs.title: A weekend by the water
paragraphs.text: If the weather stays nice this weekend, we could take the train to the coast, walk along the water, and find a quiet place to watch the sunset.

paragraphs.title: Order and delivery
paragraphs.text: Your order comes to 128 dollars after the discount, and delivery is scheduled for October 3. You can pay by card or mobile wallet, and we'll email you a receipt.

paragraphs.title: Finding the connection
paragraphs.text: Let's check whether your laptop is connected to Wi-Fi. Try refreshing the page, or close the app and open it again. If that doesn't help, tell me exactly what the error message says.

paragraphs.title: One step at a time
paragraphs.text: You've had a difficult day, and it's okay if everything didn't go according to plan. Take a breath, get some rest, and we can work out the next step together.

paragraphs.title: The good news
paragraphs.text: We finally got a reservation at the restaurant you've been talking about! I've already looked at the dessert menu, so please remind me to leave a little room after dinner.

paragraphs.title: A very serious decision
paragraphs.text: Last night I promised myself I would go to bed early, but somehow I ended up standing in front of the fridge, debating whether the last slice of cake counted as a midnight snack.

paragraphs.title: The little fox
paragraphs.text: The little fox followed the moonlit path back to her home on the hill. She placed a pine cone beside the window and whispered good night. Outside, the forest grew quiet as the wind moved through the leaves.
